chapterFiles.title: Theogony — the genealogy of the gods, from Chaos to the ordering of the cosmos under Zeus

versionTitles.ja: ホイール・オブ・ヘブン訳

subtitles.en: Hesiod's genealogy of the gods — Chaos, the Titanomachy, the ordering of the cosmos

descriptions.en: Wheel of Heaven Translation of Hesiod's *Theogony* from the Greek text of the Perseus Digital Library digital edition (canonical-greekLit tlg0020.tlg001.perseus-grc2, CC BY-SA 4.0; underlying print edition Evelyn-White, Loeb Classical Library 1914, Public Domain). The poem is treated as a single composition of 1022 lines (plus the 929a–929t variant passage), translated line by line. Source layer: complete polytonic Greek text in `source-grc-1.json`.

sourceCitation: Hesiod, Theogony. Greek text: Perseus Digital Library, canonical-greekLit urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0020.tlg001.perseus-grc2 (CC BY-SA 4.0); underlying print edition Evelyn-White, H.G., Hesiod, the Homeric Hymns and Homerica, Loeb Classical Library, London/New York 1914 (Public Domain). English translation and all WoH content original to this project.
